description: Private-repo variant of the default preset: every non-major update lands in one PR a week, because each Renovate PR runs CI on the account's paid Actions minutes. Majors still get their own PRs (also weekly), but at most two Renovate PRs are open at once: each automerge moves the base branch and Renovate rebases every other open automerge branch, rerunning its CI, so a batch of open majors costs roughly N squared runs. Security fixes skip both the schedule and the cap, and a repo's own groupName rules still win.
